description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService in the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It contains unit tests for methods like getAuthProviderDao, initiateAuthentication, getRedirectURL, getScope, getUserForAuthenticate, setOIDCUserIdentity, and handleOIDCAuthentication.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class methods in the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by instantiating the SocialMediaAuthenticationService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Tests that getAuthProviderDao returns an instance of AuthProviderDao.

methods.name: testInitiateAuthentication
methods.description: Tests the initiateAuthentication method for correct client secret, client ID, scopes, and redirect URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectURL
methods.description: Tests the getRedirectURL method to ensure it produces the expected URL string.

methods.name: testGetScope
methods.description: Verifies that getScope returns the expected scope string.

methods.name: testGetUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Checks that getUserForAuthenticate returns a User object with correct ID based on username.

methods.name: testSetOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Checks that setOIDCUserIdentity links a User to an OpenID provider identity correctly.

methods.name: testHandleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Simulates handling of OpenID Connect authentication and verifies it returns success.
